app_fee.value: International applicants pay an $80 application fee, which is non-refundable.

fee_waiver.value: Only narrow exemptions are listed: veterans, prior UA graduate applicants and UA undergraduates applying to the same program. A free application week for Fall 2027 ran October 5 to 9, 2026 and has closed.
fee_waiver.quote: Veterans and current members of the U.S. military. | Applicants previously enrolled in Graduate School at The University of Alabama. | UA undergraduates applying to the same program at the graduate level.

also.quote: The UA Graduate School will run a free graduate application (business) week from October 5 – 9, 2026 for applicants for Fall 2027.

gre_general.value: GRE rules are set program by program, so the graduate school gives no university-wide GRE rule.
gre_general.quote: Some programs, but not all, require applicants to submit a standardized test score (for example, GRE, GMAT, etc.).

toefl_min.value: The TOEFL iBT minimum is 4.5 with no section below 4; tests taken before January 2026 use the old minimum of 79.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT: 4.5 (no sub score less than 4) (or 79 for students who took the test prior to January 2026)

ielts_min.value: The IELTS Academic minimum is 6.5 overall, with no section below 6.

english_waiver.value: India is not on the graduate school's list of English-speaking countries, so an Indian degree does not waive the English test.
english_waiver.quote: You hold a degree from an institution in a recognized English-speaking country. | Recognized English-speaking Countries

notes: Program-level GRE rules are on each program record. Fee and English minimums are from the graduate school's requirements and international students pages. The free application week (October 5 to 9, 2026) is quoted from the physics FAQ, which cites the graduate school.
